navigation.confidenceNote: Counted unique name= values on <X.Screen> elements (and static `screens: {}` entries) in files importing @react-navigation. Screens whose component looks like a navigator are reported as nested navigators, not screens. Each component (component=, getComponent=, require().default, React.lazy(import()), static `screen:`) was traced through its import (relative paths, tsconfig/jsconfig paths and baseUrl, package.json imports, index files, platform variants, explicit re-exports): 78 of 78 resolved; unresolved screens keep the route file and resolved: false. Lines are non-blank lines of the component file only. Conditional stacks, dynamic names and screens registered through helpers are missed or double-counted — read the navigators.
